3.d: A carrier is there essentially all the time, over a wide area, on a frequency that is not in doubt.

2.d: Busy but intermittent. Expect to wait minutes rather than hours.

1.d: Quiet, short-range, occasional, or a frequency worth confirming. Worth programming, not worth sitting on.

std.d: Nationally or internationally allocated. Will not change.
